outreach_drafts.body:
ATTORNEY REVIEW ONLY — DO NOT SEND.
Target: RJ Scaringe
Public fact hook / hypothesis: Mind Robotics is a Rivian spinout with >$1B in funding focusing on AI-powered industrial robots. The dual relevance to AI Patent Strategy (deep technical AI/robotics with significant IP potential) and M&A Readiness (aging Rivian PE fund, spinout structure, subsidiary relationships) makes this a particularly interesting prospect. As a newly founded company with massive capital and a founder who has built and exited a company (Rivian), there is both IP creation urgency and future transaction proximity. The AI Patent Strategy Scorecard is the primary lead magnet; M&A readiness is a secondary consideration for the attorney.
Suggested lead magnet: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard — /ai-patent-strategy-scorecard
LinkedIn awareness draft exists for internal review only; do not post or tag without exact approval.

Internal LinkedIn awareness draft:
A company founded late 2025 just crossed $1 billion in funding.

That's fast.

But the real question for any company building AI-powered robots isn't how much they raised.

It's whether they documented the right things before the right people started asking.

For a spinout from an IPO'd EV company going into humanoid robotics:
- the parent-child IP relationships need to be clean,
- the human-contribution-to-AI-inventions needs to be defensible,
- and the disclosure timeline needs to be planned — not reactive.

For #founders: spinout IP is your hardest IP. Get it right from day one.
For #investors: valuation is easy. IP ownership is where the real risk lives.
For #robotics-engineers: your documentation is as important as your prototype.

Educational starting point: AI Patent Strategy Scorecard
https://whiteford-ai-law-pages.vercel.app/ai-patent-strategy-scorecard
